profile_name: D1 baseline — melee wound-overflow cap OFF (pre-D1 behaviour)
description: Turns off the melee wound-overflow cap D1 added, restoring the arithmetic the AI used before 2026-08-07: melee damage in excess of a model's Wounds characteristic counted toward the estimate, so a D3 axe was scored as killing three 1-wound models instead of one. Measured against the engine, that overvalued high-damage melee weapons by 1.6x against 2-wound models and 3.0x against 1-wound models. This profile exists so the fix can be EVALUATED — a code change applied to both sides of a mirror cannot be measured from the margin.
